description: AMPLITUDE EVENT SEGMENTATION — an event over time, with filters and group-bys. metric is uniques / totals / pct_dau / average / histogram / sums / value_avg / formula (and "formula" additionally REQUIRES `formula`, or Amplitude refuses it). Dates take YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. AMPLITUDE'S RATE LIMIT IS COST-BASED, not per-request: cost = days × conditions × query type, 1000 per 5-minute window, so one very wide query can exhaust the budget on its own — the fix for a 429 here is to NARROW the range or the conditions, not to retry. AN EMPTY RESULT IS A VALID ANSWER, not a failure: a new or low-traffic Amplitude project genuinely has no data, and reporting that as a broken connection sends the user to fix something that is working. Read-only, 0 credits.

event.description: shorthand for a single event name

events.description: one or two event specs: a plain name, or {eventType, filters:[{subprop_type,subprop_key,subprop_op,subprop_value}], groupBy:[…]}

groupBy.description: user property or event property to break the series down by, e.g. gp:utm_campaign or country

groupBy2.description: a SECOND group-by (Amplitude's g2), e.g. groupBy gp:utm_campaign + groupBy2 country

segments.description: FILTER to only these users (Amplitude's segment `s`): [{prop:'gp:utm_campaign', op:'is', values:['summer']}]. op is one of is, is not, contains, does not contain, less, less or equal, greater, greater or equal, set is, set is not. Custom user properties are gp:<name>; built-ins are country, city, region, platform, os, device_type, version, language, paying; prop userdata_cohort + a cohort id filters to a behavioural cohort. A "who performed" condition is {type:'event', event_type, op:'>=', value:1, time_type:'rolling', time_value:30} (did it at least once in the last 30 days); symbol operators only.

event_type.description: event name for a who-performed condition

op.description: property operator, e.g. is, is not, contains; symbol (>=) on a who-performed condition

prop.description: user property to filter on: built-in (country, platform), gp:<name> for custom, or userdata_cohort

type.description: 'event' for a who-performed condition; omit for a property filter

value.description: who-performed count threshold; default 1 (at least once)

values.description: values the property must match, e.g. ["summer"]

name: amplitude_segmentation
title: Amplitude event segmentation
